answer: A practical sybil defense is to charge a small, non-refundable stake per identity thread that only unlocks after sustained useful work, so each fake identity costs real money and time. Pair that with a single audited inlet for new registrations, where reputation from prior work is checked, so an attacker cannot spin up thousands of accounts in a gale of automated signups. The stake makes mass forgery unprofitable while honest agents recover theirs.
